civil_before_fy1988.description: IDB civil variables before FY1988 are not produced: the SY1988-present file holds only cases terminated from July 1, 1987, so earlier fiscal years are incomplete. (The separate 1970-1987 civil file was not processed.)

civil_mdl_docket_names_unverified.description: No GovInfo court record could be matched to these MDL docket numbers, so the atlas names them by number only: MDL 1507, MDL 2197, MDL 2299, MDL 2325, MDL 2326, MDL 2327, MDL 2391, MDL 2502, MDL 2545, MDL 2753, MDL 2782, MDL 2873, MDL 3060.
civil_mdl_docket_names_unverified.reason: litigation name not verified from an allowed source

civil_mdl_docket_not_coded_early_years.description: MDL docket numbers are almost never filled in for civil cases closed before FY 2010: 223 of 5,420,719 termination records for FY 1988 to 2009 carry one (civil_mdl_coverage.csv). MDL notes on district pages therefore start in FY 2010.
civil_mdl_docket_not_coded_early_years.reason: field not coded in the source for those years
